caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic vase with a narrow neck, wide body, and flared base, oriented upright in the center of the composition. The vase has two large, ornate handles that are decorated with a series of rounded protrusions colored in green, yellow, and purple. The body of the vase is primarily white or very pale cream with a crackled glaze effect, and it features circular decorative motifs in yellow, blue, and purple arranged around a central medallion area with faint, cursive markings or numbers inside. The neck of the vase has a band of teal or turquoise coloring near the rim, and similar turquoise bands decorate the raised bands on the stem and base, which also have brownish shading at the bottom edge. The drawing is rendered on a beige background with a faint line border and the artist's signature in the lower right corner.
title: Vase
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
